rtNames.RT3F_71: FSTORE T[#]<-FAC     ; temp slot by inline byte
rtNames.RT3F_45: DIM arr[BX]          ; # dims inline, sizes on stack
rtNames.RT3F_B5: INPUT begin prompt s$[BX] ; inline flags byte
rtNames.RT3F_B7: INPUT items          ; inline count + type bytes
rtNames.RT3F_5D: ON BX GOSUB tbl      ; inline count + words (listing=+10h)
rtNames.RT3F_5E: ON BX GOTO tbl       ; inline count + words (listing=+10h)
rtNames.RT3F_02: ON ERROR GOTO DX     ; CS offset (listing=+10h)
rtNames.RT3E_02: END (handler end: No RESUME if error active)
rtNames.RT3E_1B: BSAVE file$[BX], off DX, len CX
rtNames.RT3E_20: OPEN mode BL         ; 0 INPUT 1 OUTPUT 2 RANDOM 3 APPEND
rtNames.RT3E_5F: SOUND exec vol DX, voice BX ; -1 omitted
rtNames.RT3E_8D: GFX coord (x,y) clr flags ; BX=x DX=y CX/AX=-1 if ptr
rtNames.RT3E_86: LINE exec color BX, DX -1/0=B/1=BF, style CX
rtNames.RT3E_3A: GET exec arr[BX]     ; DX cap words
rtNames.RT3E_58: PUT (x,y),arr[BX],verb DL ; 0 OR 1 AND 2 PRESET 3 PSET 4 XOR

inlineArgs._doc: extra inline bytes after the 3-byte INT call. int = fixed count; 'b0' = value of first inline byte; tables of words hold CS offsets, listing offset = CS offset + 0x10

# SPACE — BASIC-style pseudocode (lane mod-space) — COMPLETE

Evidence: `decode/listings/SPACE.lst` (regenerated after rt-naming), `decode/data/MODULE_CONSTANTS.md` (SPACE.EXE section), `decode/data/tools/_SPACE.json` (string/numeric literal table, code end 0x99F0), `decode/brun30/RT_LEDGER.md`, `decode/data/SPRITES.md`, `decode/data/DATA_FILES.md`; read 2026-10-15. Generated mechanically by `decode/pseudo/tools/qb2bas.py` (run twice: the first pass writes `_space_try.md.vars.json` with the variable kinds the second pass uses) with `--names decode/pseudo/SPACE_names.json --tempbase A860`; this file = `decode/pseudo/SPACE_header.md` + the generated body. Every statement carries its listing offset; labels `L_XXXX` are jump targets, `SUB_XXXX` near-call targets (GOSUB bodies). Screens and flows: `decode/pseudo/SPACE_SCREENS.md`.

## Conventions

- Names come from `SPACE_names.json`; each has an `_why` evidence string (reproduced in the Variables table). Unnamed addresses would print as `N_xxxx!` (single at DS xxxx), `S_xxxx$` (string), `I_xxxx%` (integer), `A_xxxx` (array by base address); after this pass none remain in the body.
- `G!()` is the 51x51 COMMON single array at DS 0x1850 (CHARINFO.BAS = the whole game state). COMMON scalars live inside it: a variable at DS `a` with 0x1850 <= a < 0x40F4 is `G!((a-0x1850)/4)`; named ones (`Fuel!` = G!(2200), `SectorX!` = G!(2216) ...) give the index in their evidence, unnamed ones print as `G!(n)` directly.
- `DEF FN` accessors (bodies at SUB_03E2/0414/0452) are inlined at every call site by the translator (the argument stores that precede each `call` are folded into the call):
  - `FNCrew(member, field) = INT(G!(member*100 + field + 1300) + .1)` — crew record field (member 1..8, field 0..99);
  - `FNIdx(member, field) = INT(member*100 + field + 1300.5)` — index of that field, used as an assignment target `G!(CINT(FNIdx(m, f))) = ...`;
  - `FNRound2(v)` = `INT(v*100 + 1 - (INT(v*100 + 1) = 9)) / 100` — two-decimal rounding of the planet readouts (mass, gravity, diameter, density; body 0452-0490, argument `Val!`). The credits sum `INT(CreditsHi!*30000 + CreditsLo! + .5)` is the body at 0433, which no code calls (SUB_16A6 does the credits arithmetic inline).
- Compiler temp slots T0..T5 (`RT3F_71 #80..#85`, DS 0xA860 + 8*n per RT_LEDGER.md) are rendered as the expression they hold; the three addresses that appear as plain operands (0xA860 T0, 0xA870 T2, 0xA878 T3) therefore never show up as variables (the previous pass had misnamed them `ShipBankOff!`/`PicOff!`).
- FOR/NEXT are reconstructed from the compiled pattern (`jmp` to the test, counter store, compare, jump back); `NEXT x STEP n` shows a non-unit step. Conditions after FCMP/FTEST are rendered as `IF ... THEN GOTO`; `jcc L1 ; jmp L2 ; L1:` pairs are folded into `IF NOT cond THEN GOTO L2`. Boolean idioms (`mov R,0 ; jcc ; dec R`) print as BASIC relational values (-1/0), e.g. `(RND < 0.5) * 2 + 1`.
- 2-D arrays: an element index of the form `x + N*y` is printed `A(x, y)`; the first dimension (N) is noted in the Arrays table (`PixColor!`, `PixObj!`, `PixCol!` are 16 x 2).
- Integer array reads through `[reg + base]` (also with negative displacements that wrap: `[di - 0x5FF4]` = DS 0xA00C) print as `Galaxy%(i)`, `HeadX%(i)`, `PicBuf(i)`.
- `RETURN   'with FAC = expr` notes the value left in the floating accumulator at a `ret` (meaningful only for the DEF FN bodies).

## Key map (SUB_212C / SUB_1C58)

See `SPACE_SCREENS.md` "Keys". Summary: extended keys -> `Cmd!` 1..11 (2 Up, 5 Left, 7 Right, 10 Down), letters -> 12 (A) .. 37 (Z), `Cmd! = 40` = "Pilot or ship not ready"; sub-menus use SUB_1C58 (A = 1 .., ENTER = -51, SPACE = -32). Main dispatch: 1C13 (cursor keys) and 1C39 (`ON Cmd!-11 GOTO`: A galaxy scan, B switch, C computer, D sector scan, E equip, F fix, H heal, I inspect, J time delay, L load).

## Manual corrections (translator limitations; the body text is as generated)

- 21DF: generated `IF NOT ((Cmd! > 37) OR (Cmd! >= 12)) THEN GOTO L_2139`; the listing (21C0-21E1: `mov bx,0 ; jae ; dec bx` = `Cmd! < 12`, `mov dx,0 ; jbe ; dec dx` = `Cmd! > 37`, `or`, `je ret`) means `IF (Cmd! < 12) OR (Cmd! > 37) THEN GOTO L_2139` (reject anything that is not a letter). Translator request filed in STATUS.md.
- 3E38 `PRINT "Star"; -StarNo!` and 576B `LEFT$(STR$(-PlanetNo!(Idx!)), 2)`: the negations are real (`RT3F_AF`/`RT3F_B1`); STR$ of a negative number has no leading space, so the screen shows e.g. `Star-3` / `Planet-2`.
- 25AA-25D9 and 25E0-2625 are reachable only by fall-through from SUB_2544's `GOTO L_2544` loop (never) - dead code blocks (a `" is dead."` message and a three-letter yes/no input).
- 2129 `GOTO L_1B5D` after SUB_2056's last RETURN and 019F7 / 08B32 / 08BC5 (`RETURN` after `RETURN`) are compiler padding between routines.
- 0x99B4-0x99EE after the last `ret` is data (the `' asm` lines at the end).

## Unknowns

No runtime call is left unrendered (see the table at the end). Open points of interpretation (all marked M in the Variables table): `Difficulty!` (0xAB8C) is only known from its use as an item range / enemy strength factor; the meaning of `G!(0)` vs `G!(3)` ("Pilot or ship not ready") is not separable from SPACE alone; crew fields 55, 90, 91 and ship-item field +1 are read without a printed label.

STARPORT.header:
# STARPORT — BASIC-style pseudocode (lane mod-starport) — COMPLETE

Evidence: `decode/listings/STARPORT.lst` (regenerated after rt-naming), `decode/data/MODULE_CONSTANTS.md` (STARPORT.EXE section), `decode/data/tools/_STARPORT.json` (literal table, code end 0xAD00), `decode/brun30/RT_LEDGER.md` (incl. the corrected 3F_B7 INPUT type bytes and the 3E_58 PUT verb map), `decode/data/SPRITES.md`, `decode/data/DATA_FILES.md` (NAME, MISSION, CHARINFO, CHARNAME, INFO.BAS); read 2026-10-15. The codex draft `STARPORT.draft.md` served only as a literal map; every statement is re-derived from the listing by `decode/pseudo/tools/qb2bas.py` (commit 541b493 or later: PUT verbs 0 OR/1 AND/2 PRESET/3 PSET/4 XOR, INPUT types 01 integer/02 single/03 double/04 string) run twice with `--names decode/pseudo/STARPORT_names.json --tempbase A87C`. This file = `decode/pseudo/STARPORT_header.md` + the generated body. Screens and flows: `decode/pseudo/STARPORT_SCREENS.md`.

## Conventions

Same as `SPACE.bas.md` / `SPBATTLE.bas.md`: labels = offsets, `SUB_XXXX` = near-call targets, `G!()` = the COMMON array at DS 0x1850 (fixed-index elements print as `G!(n)`), compiler temp slots T0..T31 at 0xA87C + 8n (the 256-byte block ending the 260-byte gap 0xA878..0xA97C in the literal table; T0 = 0xA87C is the SPPIC BLOAD offset at 10B7 = `&H4926`) rendered as the expression they hold, FOR/NEXT reconstructed (the step, when not 1, is printed on the `NEXT x STEP s` line, never on the FOR line), bool idioms as relational values.

DEF FN accessors inlined at every call site:

| FN | definition | body |
|---|---|---|
| `FNCrew(m, f)` | `INT(G!(m*100 + f + 1300) + .1)` | SUB_0797 |
| `FNIdx(m, f)` | `INT(m*100 + f + 1300.5)` | SUB_07C9 |
| `FNCredits(0)` | `INT(CreditsHi!*30000 + CreditsLo! + .5)` (dummy argument) | SUB_07E8 |

Price/stat tables come from INFO.BAS (`BLOAD Drive$+"INFO.BAS", &H51F6`, 020F): single arrays whose field f of item i sits at `base + (i + f*count)*4`, so the body shows e.g. `GunTable!(CINT(GunIdx!) + 100)` = price column of 25 guns. The Arrays table names each table and lists its columns as used. Ship pictures come from SHIPPICS.BAS (`&H4F9E`), the starport picture from SPPIC-n.BAS (`&H4926`), the medal animation from "fire" (`&H65AE`, FIRE.BAS).

## Key map

`SUB_22C4`: letters -> `Cmd!` 1.. (A = 1), ENTER -51, SPACE -32, ESC -37 (used by the pick lists), accepted within `CmdMin!..CmdMax!`. `SUB_1F14` crew picker: ENTER 0, P 1, C 2, 1..6 -> 3..8 (existing members only). `SUB_28BA` Y/N, `SUB_2950` typed YES/NO. `SUB_24F4` line editor (digits only when `MaxLen! = 3.9`). `SUB_A422` single digit. Main menu dispatch 227D: A Personnel (L_543C), B Buy (L_37D0), C Sell (L_2BB3), D Dry Dock (L_667D), E Training (L_7C01), F Fuel (L_2396), G Game Save (L_9AA7), H Headquarters (L_7515), I Inspect (L_83FC), K Christen (L_9F45), L Leave (L_9D9C), M Medical (L_6E43), T Time Delay (L_A8A7).

## G!() layout used by STARPORT (in addition to the SPACE / SPBATTLE tables)

| indices | meaning | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 0..6 | ship equipment slots set to 1 with a new ship | 2B75-2B99 |
| 20..22 | drop-ship parts from the ship table | 2A16-2A55 |
| 28 | `ShipTable!(+108)` of the bought ship | 2B6C |
| 43 | ship index + 1 (0 = no ship) | 2AFA, 3509, 37B2, 8D50, 9E12 |
| 60/61, 63/64, 62, 65 | missile killer / defence hardware type, %, weights x10 | 4EBB-4EE9, 4FBE-4FEC |
| 63 + 3n (n = 1..4) | shield slots: type, +1 strength, +2 weight x10; flag `G!(n+6)` | 4D1E-4DE9, A4C5-A55D |
| 100..109 | special bonus flags (1 -> paid, 2) | SUB_13DC |
| 110..159 | mission flags: 0 none, 1 active, 2 completed (paid -> 3) | 18F7-1928, 754B-7933 |
| 160..209 | espionage finds (1 found -> 2 rewarded) | 18AF-18D5, 98D2 |
| 210..309, 310..315 | kill list, pointers | 1779-183E |
| 320..339 | tow list (type / tonnage) | 184D-1899 |
| 340..369 | gun ammo stock (gun type), weight at +30 | 4B3F-4C44, 3184 |
| 400..499 | cargo items; `CargoValue!` on sale | 3241 |
| 500..554 | reload counts per weapon type (rebuilt by SUB_9FED / SUB_A596); `G!(541+row)` list map | A00E-A093, A80B |
| 683 + 7n (n = 1..6) | gun records: type, +1 damage, +2 ammo capacity, +3 weight x10, +4 accuracy, +5 loaded, +6 shots; flag `G!(n+10)` | 4895-4A7D, 30B8 |
| 726 + k (k = 16..32) | miscellaneous items shown by "E-Miscellaneous Items" | 99BC-9A04 |
| 742..758 | set to 1 in the test setup | 0FA4 |
| 800..1088 (step 12) | squad weapons: type, +1 max damage, +2 rate of fire (shots per round), +3 loaded ammo (= +4 at purchase), +4 magazine capacity, +5 weight x10, +6 damage type 1..12, +7 to-hit bonus, +8 intimidation factor, +9 owner, +10 range, +11 weapon/skill type 1..4 (column meanings from the PLBATTLE use sites 06CF4/067ED/0669A/068A6/0405B/056B3/06924 and manual p12-13) | 3CFF-3EC0 |
| 1100..1397 (step 3) | ammo: type, +1 weight x10, +2 owner | 409E-40F3 |
| 1300 + 100m + f | crew records: 0..6 attributes, 5 esper potential (> 50 = Esper allowed), 7..99 cleared at recruitment, 8 move, 9 training sessions due, 10/11 bonuses, 12 max move, 13 max carried, 14 carried, 15/16 HP, 17..28 skill levels (`Skill$(1..12)`), 29 age days, 31 status, 32 first weapon record, 34 rank, 35 class, 36 last aging year, 41..43 sighting hardware, 44..46 hand weapon, 47..49 armor suit, 50 clones, 54 = attr5/25, 59 medal flag, 90/91 item numbers | FNCrew/FNIdx sites |
| 2199..2212 | last-mission / last-visit year and day (`PayYear!`, `PayDay!`, `VisitYear!`, `VisitDay!`) | 10F5-1103, 19BE, 1BCF |
| 2230..2244 | mission parameters read from the MISSION record (15 integers) | 765E-768A |
| 2261/2262 | saved mission codes restored into `MissionCodeA!/B!` | 10C3, 76B9 |
| 2264 | tribute counter (reset with a new mission) | 7797 |
| 2265 | save lock after two consecutive wrong rule-book answers (Tries! starts at 1, retries while <= 2) | 9AAF-9CDB |
| 2300, 2597 | test setup values | 092B, 0934 |

## Manual corrections (translator limitations; the body text is as generated)

- 4895, 4945, 4B04, 4CC2, 4D1E: `word ptr [0xae70]` inside `imul` expressions is the integer variable `NumIn%` (the translator resolves absolute memory operands only in `mov`/`cmp`): read `7 * NumIn% + 683` and `3 * NumIn% + 63`. Request filed in STATUS.md.
- 0ACC8 `N(?) = 0` and 0ACCB `GOSUB SUB_0AAE` are stray renders of the padding/data bytes after the error-handler `END` at ACC2 (`SUB_0AAE` does not exist); the `' asm` lines up to ACFE are data.
- Unreferenced blocks (no `call`/`jmp` reaches them): 08A7-1071 test-ship setup (reached only through the never-set `DebugLoad!`), 22BB-22C1 (`Years! = 74`), 2920-294F (" is dead."), 7805-7936 (`INPUT "TRY WHICH MISSION (1-50)?"; Flag!` mission chooser - the INPUT item type 02 renders as the single `Flag!`), 793F-7986 (medal reset), A40A-A421 (duplicate case).
- `A_4534$` is named `MiscItemName$` here; SPACE_names.json calls the same NAME array `HandWeaponName$` (SPACE prints it under "Hand Weapon" for the items in G!(2300..2597)); STARPORT shows those items are the 11 "F-Miscellaneous" purchases and the 6 hand weapons are `A_44CC$` - noted in STATUS.md for the SPACE owner.

## Unknowns

No runtime call is left unrendered. Interpretation points marked M in the Variables table: the INFO.BAS column meanings are inferred from their use (columns written into record fields without a printed label keep a `field n` description); `G!(28)`, `G!(2300)`, `G!(2597)`, `G!(742..758)` are written without a readable purpose; `A6D4` `PriceFactor!` is 1.2 at all three starports.

Addresses below 0x40F4 are elements of the COMMON array G! (index = (addr-0x1850)/4); 0x40F4..0x7FAA = other COMMON variables shared with SPACE/PLBATTLE; above = INSIDE locals. # INSIDE — BASIC-style pseudocode (lane mod-inside)

Evidence: `decode/listings/INSIDE.lst` (regenerated after rt-naming), `decode/data/tools/_INSIDE.json` (string/number literal table, DATA records, LINES table of `decode/data/MODULE_CONSTANTS.md` section INSIDE.EXE), `decode/brun30/RT_LEDGER.md`, `decode/data/DATA_FILES.md` / `SPRITES.md` (IN-n, INMAP-n, MES-n, INSH, NAME), the NAME file itself for the string-array indices; all read 2026-10-15. The codex draft `INSIDE.draft.md` was used as a scaffold only; every statement below was re-derived from the listing by `decode/pseudo/tools/qb2bas.py`:

```
python decode/pseudo/tools/qb2bas.py decode/listings/INSIDE.lst decode/data/tools/_INSIDE.json decode/pseudo/INSIDE.bas.md --title INSIDE --names decode/pseudo/INSIDE_names.json --end 71E3 --tempbase 8968
```

(run twice so that the INPUT-type pre-pass sees the variable kinds; `--end 71E3` stops at the last reachable instruction, the 13 bytes 71E3..71EF have no incoming edge and the metadata block 22 starts at 71F0; `--tempbase 8968`: the compiler's temp slot T0 is DS 0x8968 — proven by `RT3F_71 #80` at 060EF followed by `mov dx,0x8968` as the PUT y operand at 06104, and T1 = 0x8970 at 04CA2.)

## Conventions

- Every statement carries its listing offset; `L_XXXX:` = jump target, `SUB_XXXX:` = near-call target (GOSUB). `GOTO`/`IF ... THEN GOTO` are the compiled jumps; FOR/NEXT are reconstructed from the compiled counter-store/compare pattern (three shapes: short `jbe BODY`, long `ja +3 / jmp BODY`, and variable STEP with the sign test). Translator convention (all modules): the `FOR x = a TO b` line never shows the step; a non-unit or variable step is printed on the matching `NEXT x STEP s` line.
- Names come from `INSIDE_names.json` (every name has an `_why` evidence entry, listing offsets in hex). Unnamed items keep `N_xxxx!` (single at DS xxxx), `S_xxxx$`, `A_xxxx!(i)`. `G!()` is the 51x51 COMMON array (CHARINFO.BAS at DS 0x1850); DS addresses below 0x40F4 are its elements, index = (addr - 0x1850) / 4, so `DriveCfg!` = G!(85), `UseEGA!` = G!(89), `StdDelay!` = G!(86), `Delay!` = G!(88), `CreditsHi!/CreditsLo!` = G!(78)/G!(79), `SectorX!` = G!(2216), `InBattle!` = G!(2255), `Breathable!` = G!(2252), and the four values handed to PLBATTLE are G!(2214), G!(2228), G!(2229), G!(2260).
- DEF FN bodies (the five one-expression subroutines at 0359..0426) are inlined at their call sites as `FNCrew(member, field)`, `FNIdx(member, field)`, `FNRoom(room, field)`, `FNRoomIdx(room, field)`, `FNCell(0)`; the compiled form is `argument stores ; call ; FAC`. `FNCrew` addresses the squad records at 1500 + member*100 (member 1..6), which are the ship crew slots 3..8 of SPACE's `FNCrew` (1300 + crew*100): the module shifts `CrewName$` by two on entry (0303) and back before every CHAIN (SUB_4F07).
- Conditions: `(a > b)` as a value is the BASIC boolean -1/0; `IF NOT (...) THEN GOTO` is the compiled "skip" form (the source probably read `IF ... THEN <block>`).
- `' with FAC = ...` on a RETURN = the value a DEF FN body leaves in the accumulator.
- Runtime-call semantics are the ledger's; nothing in this module is unrendered (see Unknowns / open questions below).

## Module structure (offsets)

| range | content |
|---|---|
| 0040-00B3 | `Drive$` from `DriveCfg!`, `Enclosure$(0..2)`, `SndDur!`, `BLOAD INSH.BAS` to &H82D6 |
| 00BC-0356 | standalone-test loading guarded by `TestMode!` (always 0 at run time, see names): CHARINFO, LOGO, NAME (Rank$ 1..13, Skill$ 0..15, skip 130, MiscItemName$ 0..10, skip 197, AttrName$ 0..6), CHARNAME; the normal path only shifts `CrewName$` by two (0303) |
| 0359-0426 | the DEF FN bodies (FNCrew, FNIdx, an unused FNKey copy at 03A7, FNRoom, FNRoomIdx, FNCell) |
| 0427-068B | `TestMode!`-only debug initialisation ("Change things?") |
| 068E-07F9 | `RANDOMIZE TIMER`, frame (SUB_0DEE), `Location!`/`StartX!`/`StartY!` from `SectorX!`: <=5 -> 4 (17,0); 6 -> 7 (18,0); 7..10 -> 5 (25,0); 11..14 -> 3 (4,3); 15..18 -> 6 (3,8); 19..30 -> 1 (18,8); >30 -> 2 (9,28) |
| 07F9-0829 | fresh entry (`InBattle!` = 0): load the location (SUB_63F9) ; return from PLBATTLE: read MES-n only (SUB_6473) and restore the map |
| 0829-0CDF | `Breathable!` (0 for locations 3 and 6, 1 elsewhere); the atmosphere/oxygen check runs only on a fresh entry (InBattle! = 0) when it is 0 (088F): members need items 10, 8 and 9 (flags in fields 33/56/40, product -> field 40); "Atmosphere Unbreathable", list of members with oxygen, "Some squad members have no oxygen source. Will you continue? (Y/N)": N -> save names and `CHAIN SPACE.STR`, Y -> every living member without oxygen takes 999 hits (dies) |
| 0CDF-0DEB | READ `OpLen%(0..26)` and `OptionName$(1..22)`; position: fresh entry -> `StartX!/StartY!`; back from battle (`InBattle!`): `BattleWon!` = 0 -> back to `OldX!/OldY!` (0D51-0D68), nonzero -> stay and mark the room's enemy group -1 (cleared, 0D86-0DA4) |
| 0DEE-0FFA | SUB_0DEE: the screen frame |
| 0FFB-1707 | helper subroutines (delays, member picker, key readers, line editor, panel clears, map save/restore) |
| 1707-17A8 | SUB_1707 item search; 17AF-1ABC unreachable leftover (derives a member's stats) |
| 1ABD-2407 | Y/N, room drawing (SUB_1B23 + the 64-case tile PUT SUB_1CEA) |
| 2408-2650 | main loop head: command list, cursor, `RoomNo!`, passability digits, key dispatch `ON Cmd! GOTO` (Up/Left/Right/Down, C E F G I M R S T U V) |
| 2650-2830 | new room: `Enclosure$`, room text (14-char rows), draw if unmapped, enemies -> 64E4, script -> 6BF2, else 34C5 |
| 2830-2F18 | the four moves (blocked -> SOUND 900) and the trap event (radiation 1..3 / explosive 4..6; detection by the radiation detector or a Scout roll; disarm by `Scout!`) |
| 2F18-34B7 | the vault door (A-Leave, B-Use Torch, C-Fire At Door, D-Pick Lock) |
| 34B7-35BD | room bookkeeping, "The Exit" (Y -> save names, BSAVE IN-n/INMAP-n, `CHAIN SPACE.STR`), 1% random encounter per step (TestMode 0) |
| 35C0-37C0 | G-Switch: exchange two members' records, names and item ownership |
| 37C3-3C53 | F-Fix Items: best Ship Repair member, repair kit (item 2), armour (fields 48/49/55) and weapons (ammo field -1 broken -> -2 unfixable / 0 fixed), summary |
| 3C56-41B5 | M-Medical: A-Squad Health table, B-Heal Member (best Medical, medkit item 1, +4 HP or full, 20% medkit used up) |
| 41B8-4B2D | I-Inspect: page 1 stats, page 2 skills, page 3 armour/items/weapons (SUB_4B30 recomputes weight and movement) |
| 4F07-4F7D | SUB_4F07 un-shift names |
| 4F7E-53D7 | E-Equip: EQUIPING list of weapons (800+12k, owner > 2), ammo ("Ammo For "), items; A-R changes an item's owner 3..8 |
| 53DA-5741 | V-View: a member with esper level >= 7 and field 54 > 0 (decremented), 10 sounds, map flashed with PRESET, rooms within 2 cells revealed, "Beings!" / "No Life" |
| 5744-597B | detector sweep animations (radiation: top/bottom edge, motion: left/right edge) |
| 597C-5D4D | C-Change Wep.: cycle through the member's weapons with SPACE, ENTER selects (field 32; field 37 = 3 when changed) |
| 5D4E-5EF0 | R-Reload all weapons with ammo 0 from matching ammo items |
| 5EF1-5F67 | S-Search: "You Find Nothing Unusual" unless the room has a script (-> 6BF2) |
| 5F6A-60BB | U-Use: A/B activate the motion (items 3/4) or radiation (item 11) detector |
| 60BE-6216 | SUB_60BE background tick (detectors + squad marker), SUB_6169 best Scout |
| 6217-6386 | SUB_6217 damage/death, "You Are All Dead" (endless loop) |
| 6387-64E2 | save/load the location files, read MES-n |
| 64E4-6655 | encounter: surprise roll `RND*100 < 50 - MotDetOn!*20 + enclosure*20` (0 confrontation / 1 you surprise / 2 enemies surprise, random +0..1 with a 3 folded to 0), then `CHAIN PLBATTLE.EXE` |
| 6658-6891 | spacebar wait, reload counts, list-line word wrap |
| 6892-695F | T-Time Delay: standard/current/new delay (1..9999) |
| 6962-6BF1 | SUB_6962 option picker + typed single word |
| 6BF2-71E0 | the interaction-script interpreter (see the opcode table) |

## Data formats found here (for DATA_FILES.md)

- **IN-n.BAS** (`InMap%`, BLOAD at &H48B0, BSAVEd back with 5502 bytes = 2751 words when the player takes the exit): words 0..1368 = 37x37 cells, index `y*37 + x`, value `room*64 + tile`; words 1369.. = room records of 11 words at `1369 + room*11`: 0 trap level (1..3 radiation, 4..6 explosive), 1 enemy group (-1 none; >= 0 -> PLBATTLE), 2 script pointer (0 none; negative = one-shot), 3 MES-n line number of the description, 4 enclosure 0..2, 5 mapped flag, 6 vault door strength (sign flips after a failed pick), 7..10 rectangle x0 y0 x1 y1; scripts follow (see opcodes); words 1930..1932 = random-encounter enemy groups. The explored flags and consumed one-shot scripts are saved into the file, so the shipped IN-n files carry state.
- **INSH.BAS** (`TilePass%`, BLOAD at &H82D6, 1228 bytes): words 0..63 = 4-digit decimal code of the blocked directions of tile 0..63 (a SET digit blocks the move: thousands = down, hundreds = up, tens = right, units = left; 0 = open on all sides; polarity verified at 2833-285A: nonzero -> SOUND 900, zero -> move), then 64 GET arrays of 14 bytes (5x5 CGA tiles) at 0x8356 + 14*t, the 24x28 command-panel cursor at 0x86D6 (PUT (280,144) XOR), and two 8x6 detector blips at 0x8782 / 0x8792. Tile 42 doubles as the squad marker (PUT (x*5+8, y*5+7) XOR), 34/35 are the vault door, 36..40 traps, 41 the exit.
- **INMAP-n.BAS** (`MapPic`, BLOAD at &H5E2E): the 185x185 picture of the map area (8,7)-(192,191); redrawn rooms are BSAVEd back (8700 bytes).
- **MES-n**: one line per room (index = room field 3), 14-character cells; a 3-letter line at index k is a typed-command keyword giving `Option!` = k + 100; lines 0..100 are searched.
- **Script opcodes** (`InMap%` words from the room's field 2; `OpLen%` = words per opcode from DATA line 3331; arguments are the following words):

| op | len | effect (label) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | nothing (6BF8) |
| 1 | 2 | battle with enemy group Arg1, `Surprise!` = 0 (6D30 -> SUB_656F) |
| 2 | 2 | show `MesLine$(Arg1)` in the map panel, 23 chars per row (6D59) |
| 3 | 3 | `G!(Arg1) = Arg2` (6E46) |
| 4 | 3 | `X! = Arg1: Y! = Arg2` (6E5F) |
| 5 | 3 | `InMap%(Arg1) = Arg2` (6E74) |
| 6 | 2 | credits + Arg1 (6E8D) |
| 7 | 3 | every living member: field Arg1 + Arg2 (6E9C) |
| 8 | 2 | `IF G!(Arg1+109) = 1 THEN G!(Arg1+109) = 2` (6F2E) |
| 9 | 1 | option picker (6F5A -> SUB_6962) |
| 10 | 2 | "Nothing unusual happens", jump to Arg1 (6F60) |
| 11 | 2 | "Not valid or possible", jump to Arg1 (6F87) |
| 12 | 2 | "What?", jump to Arg1 (6FAE) |
| 13 | 3 | `IF Option! = Arg1 THEN` jump to Arg2 (6FD5) |
| 14 | 2 | jump to Arg1 (6FEF) |
| 15 | 3 | `IF RND*100 < Arg1 THEN` jump to Arg2 (6FFB) |
| 16 | 4 | `IF G!(Arg1) <= Arg2 THEN` jump to Arg3 (701B) |
| 17 | 4 | `IF G!(Arg1) >= Arg2 THEN` jump to Arg3 (7042) |
| 18 | 1 | "Enter Amount:" -> `Amount!` (7069) |
| 19 | 3 | `IF Amount! >= Arg1 THEN` jump to Arg2 (7097) |
| 20 | 2 | credits + Arg1 * `Amount!` (70B1) |
| 21 | 3 | `IF credits >= Arg1 THEN` jump to Arg2 (70C6) |
| 22 | 1 | end: restore the map, back to the command loop (70EC) |
| 23 | 2 | as 2 plus "Press ENTER" (70F2) |
| 24 | 2 | every living member takes INT(RND*Arg1 + 1) hits (70F5) |
| 25 | 1 | `X!, Y! = OldX!, OldY!` (71A0) |
| 26 | 2 | unmap room Arg1 and force a redraw (71B5) |

A negative opcode word marks a one-shot instruction: after it is read the whole instruction is zeroed (6C75-6CB6) and the saved IN-n file keeps it zeroed.

## Dead / unreferenced code

- 03A7-03C5: a DEF FN body `INT(CreditsHi!*30000 + CreditsLo! + .5)` (SPACE's FNKey) with no caller.
- 01067-01082 ("Select Option" + key wait), 0154E-01551 (LINE), 017AF-01ABC (member stat derivation using DbgEsper!): no label reaches them (they follow a RETURN); compiler leftovers of removed GOSUBs.
- 0427-068B, 00BC-0300, 27CD, 6D3E: reachable only with `TestMode!` <> 0, which nothing sets.
- 71E3-71EF: 13 bytes after the last `GOTO L_6BF8`, no incoming edge (not rendered).

## LINES table

The module's LINES block maps source line numbers to offsets: lines 1/3/10 -> 0040, 20 -> 00BC, 30 -> 00C2, 40 -> 00EE, 100 -> 00FB, 300 -> 0118. Only these early lines are recorded (the table has 8 entries), consistent with `ON ERROR`-style references in the source; no line numbers are invented elsewhere.

## Unknowns / open questions

- No runtime call is unrendered (the generated Unknowns table at the end of this file is empty).
- `BattleWon!` (G!(2254), PLBATTLE 430D = credits gained or a surrender): read once after a return from PLBATTLE (0D51, `FCMP [3B88] ? 0; je 0D56`): 0 -> the squad is put back on `OldX!/OldY!`, nonzero -> it stays on the encounter cell and the room is marked (0D6B-0DA4). (Polarity corrected 2026-10-18, glm-review-crossref D1.)
- `N_3B78!` (G!(2250)) is set to 10 for locations 4 and 1 and never read here (PLBATTLE reads it as the gravity x10); `N_9018!` is incremented by Fix and never read.
- `Breathable!` (G!(2252)) is 0 for locations 3 and 6 and 1 elsewhere; the atmosphere/oxygen screen runs only on a fresh entry (`InBattle!` = 0) when it is 0 (088F); PLBATTLE prints "Breathable" for 1, so the polarity is proven there.
- `GunName$` (A_43F4) is a COMMON string array loaded by STARPORT/PLBATTLE (NAME items 81..134).
- `FOR I! = FirstRow! TO LastRow!` at 2717: `FirstRow!` (0x8D82) is never assigned; the loop starts at 0 at run time.
- The unreachable blocks listed under "Dead / unreferenced code" are rendered but not reachable.

# PLBATTLE — BASIC-style pseudocode (lane mod-plbattle)

Evidence: `decode/listings/PLBATTLE.lst` (regenerated after rt-naming), `decode/data/tools/_PLBATTLE.json` (literal table, DATA records 241/297/6903/7171/7172, code end 0xA960), `decode/brun30/RT_LEDGER.md` (3E_58 verb map, corrected 3F_B7 INPUT types), `decode/data/SPRITES.md` (BIGSH-n, PLBTSH, TR-n, LOGO.EGA), `decode/data/DATA_FILES.md` and the ENCINFO file itself (25 records of a name and 27 integers); read 2026-10-15. The codex draft `PLBATTLE.draft.md` was used as a literal map only; every statement is re-derived from the listing by `decode/pseudo/tools/qb2bas.py`:

```
python decode/pseudo/tools/qb2bas.py decode/listings/PLBATTLE.lst decode/data/tools/_PLBATTLE.json decode/pseudo/PLBATTLE.bas.md --title PLBATTLE --names decode/pseudo/PLBATTLE_names.json --tempbase BE88 --end A921
```

(run twice; `--end A921`: the last reachable instruction is the `ret` at A920, bytes A921..A92F have no incoming edge and block 22 starts at A930; `--tempbase BE88`: compiler temp slot T0 = DS 0xBE88, proven by `RT3F_71 #83` at 0199F followed by `mov dx,0xBEA0` (= 0xBE88 + 3*8) as the BLOAD offset at 019BA, and 13 further T3 reads.) This file = `decode/pseudo/PLBATTLE_header.md` + the generated body. Screens and flows: `decode/pseudo/PLBATTLE_SCREENS.md`.

## Conventions

- Statements carry their listing offset; `L_XXXX:` jump targets, `SUB_XXXX:` GOSUB bodies; FOR/NEXT reconstructed from the compiled counter pattern (112 loops, including the variable-STEP form). Convention of the translator in every module: the `FOR x = a TO b` line never shows the step; a non-unit or variable step is printed on the matching `NEXT x STEP s` line (e.g. `0201B FOR J! = 1100 TO 1397` ... `020BD NEXT J! STEP 3`).
- Names come from `PLBATTLE_names.json` (each with an `_why` evidence entry). `G!()` is the COMMON array at DS 0x1850; addresses below 0x40F4 are its elements: `DriveCfg!` G!(85), `StdDelay!` G!(86), `Delay!` G!(88), `UseEGA!` G!(89), `SoundOff!` G!(93), `CreditsHi!/Lo!` G!(78)/(79), `ChainArg!` G!(2214), `EntryMode!` G!(2227), `Terrain!` G!(2228), `Surprise!` G!(2229), `Gravity10!` G!(2250), `BoardCrew!` G!(2251), `Breathable!` G!(2252), `BattleWon!` G!(2254), `Enclosure!` G!(2260), and the boarding bookkeeping G!(6), G!(109), G!(310..315), G!(330..339), G!(2236/2237/2240/2263).
- Eight DEF FN bodies (06A9..1953) are inlined: `FNCrew(member, field)` / `FNIdx(member, field)` on the squad records 1500 + member*100 (member 1..6 = ship crew 3..8; names shifted by two at 0659 and back by SUB_9685), `FNDist(a, b)` between position slots, `FNRanged(g)` / `FNInRange(g)` (group within twice / once the weapon reach), `FNMap(s)` terrain under a slot, `FNOffMap(s)`, `FNPassable(s)`.
- Position slots: 0..3 enemy groups, 5 the squad (`GrpX!(5)/GrpY!(5)`; the decode had rendered these direct operands as scalars `SquadX!/SquadY!`, likewise `TileX!/TileY!` = slot 6, `ExitX!/ExitY!` = 7, `CenterX!/CenterY!` = 8 - sweep-folded), 6 the last offensive cell, 7 the bottom exit (32.5, 99), 8 the map centre (32.5, 11.5). Coordinates are text cells (8 px): map columns 26..39, rows 5..18; the 7x7 battlefield cells are 16 px at x = 184 + 16i, y = 16 + 16j (i, j = 1..7), `FNMap` = `Map%(INT(x/2 - 12) + INT(y/2 - 1.5)*9)`.
- Per-unit arrays are indexed `group*5 + unit` (groups 0..3, units 0..4). Per-group arrays by group.
- `' dynamic array (descriptor)` marks PUT/GET on the three DIM'd arrays (`HdrSave`, `MapSave`, `BoxSave`, 0040-005D; DH <> 0 in the PUT verb word).
- Screen mode: `SCREEN 7` (320x200, 16 colours) when `UseEGA!` = 1 (0072), otherwise the inherited SCREEN 1; sprite files `.EGA` / `.BAS` are chosen accordingly (0301-0380, 1954-19FB); the EGA path also BLOADs `LOGO.EGA` into `BoxSave` (0349) for the title box (25DA-2609), while the CGA path draws no logo of its own on the normal path (the only `BLOAD "LOGO"` is the debug path 0509; the CGA logo at 0x40F4 comes from STARTUP's COMMON load).

## Module structure (offsets)

| range | content |
|---|---|
| 0040-005D | DIM HdrSave(3138), MapSave(4098), BoxSave(2210) |
| 0061-00C7 | SCREEN 7 (EGA), Drive$, PLAY "MF", Pi!, SndDur! |
| 00D0-0129 | READ AttackVerb$(1..4), TerrainName$(1..13) |
| 0140-0167 | `DebugLoad!`-only CHARINFO load (never taken) |
| 016A-02D0 | entry values (Gravity!, Atmos!, SurpriseCur!, TerrType!), intro text: GROUND COMBAT, surprise line, gravity/fatigue, atmosphere, location |
| 02FC-04D7 | TR-n tiles (+ LOGO.EGA), terrain legend, escape instructions |
| 04DD-06A6 | Status$, `DebugLoad!`-only NAME/CHARNAME loading, name shift |
| 06A9-1953 | DEF FN bodies (an unused credits FN at 06F7) |
| 0716-0E33 | `DebugLoad!`-only "Change things?" debug fill |
| 0E36-1784 | RANDOMIZE; ENCINFO loading: records from ChainArg!, group creation (size, position clash test, per-unit initiative/armour/HP/rockets/flames/melee), name split, boarding override, "Group A: n name(s)", following groups by columns 22-24 |
| 1787-1A8A | squad position (33,12), BIGSH portrait and PLBTSH banks, Squad movement |
| 1AB4-1C00 | move tables, READ CmdName$(0..10), comms tables |
| 1C13-1D64 | round state, weapon-slot validation, stamina (field 58 = 3 x movement) |
| 1D6D-1F77 | oxygen check (items 10/8/9 -> fields 33/56/40) when unbreathable |
| 1F7D-21E3 | auto-reload of empty weapons from ammo items, esper derived fields 51..53 |
| 22AC-28E9 | the battle screen (SUB layout at SCREENS.md), portrait tick, member list, enemy grid, map |
| 2913-34B9 | helpers (delays, credits, A:R column, pickers, key readers, panel clears, line editor, dead code 310A-34B9) |
| 3570-3D01 | round head: Communications (y/n, translator/ESP roll, approach/objective menus, outcome, truce/tribute/surrender) |

## Data formats found here (for DATA_FILES.md)

- **ENCINFO** (25 lines): `name$, c1 .. c27`. Columns as used: c1 max group size, c2 initiative base (x1.3/x0.7/x0.6 = `InitHi!/InitMid!/InitLo!`, the bounds of the initiative countdown 1039-1055, 6587-659D - not morale: group morale is SUB_3D68), c3 to-hit modifier against the group, c4 unit armour, c5 squares per turn, c6 hit points base, c7 attitude 1..3 (a bribe offer is `(c7 < 4) * -40` = +40 at 399D, i.e. it starts at 40 instead of 50 and never fails outright), c8 hostility (1 passive, >1 attacks with chance 35*c8-35 %), c9 tactic 1..5, c10 BIGSH portrait number, c11 unused, c12 credits per unit, c13 strength per unit, c14 unused, c15/c17 rocket chance and count, c19/c21 flame-thrower chance and charges, c25 melee attacks, c16/c18/c20 rocket/melee/flame damage, c22 chance of a following group, c23/c24 the following records, c26 melee reach, c27 attack verb 1..4 (also the creature sprite). Records are read from `ChainArg!` (G!(2214)); extra groups follow the record links until 4 groups or a failed c22 roll.
- **BIGSH-n.BAS/.EGA**: the 88x56 portrait at the start; after it a frame script of integers (CGA: from word 618, one frame number 1..5 per 0.123 s, terminated by 0; EGA: from word 1240, pairs (frame type 1..4, delay in 1/100 s), terminated by a negative word) with XORed overlay frames at 0x8AF2/0x8ED4/0x91D0 placed by the integer pairs at 0x89F6..0x8A00 — i.e. the .EGA files carry their own animation offsets.
- **PLBTSH.EGA/.BAS** (18 GET arrays at &HAC70 = file offset 7; the slots are not uniform - offsets and spacing from `sprites_index.tsv`: 0 16x16@7 (+132), 1 16x16@139 (+132), 2 16x16@271 (+132), 3 24x24@403 (+292), 4 24x24@695 (+292), 5 24x24@987 (+292), 6 24x24@1279 (+292), 7 24x24@1571 (+292), 8 26x24@1863 (+388), 9 1x1@2251 (+8), 10 3x3@2259 (+16), 11 4x4@2275 (+20), 12 24x24@2295 (+292), 13 24x24@2587 (+292), 14 24x24@2879 (+292), 15 16x16@3171 (+132), 16 16x16@3303 (+132), 17 16x16@3435; only the 16x16 slots are 132 bytes, the 24x24 ones 292, cursor to Shot1 388): 0 laser-creature, 1 rocket unit, 2 flame unit, 3..7 big explosion frames, 8 the 26x24 menu cursor, 9 1x1 dot shot, 10 3x3 shot, 11 4x4 rocket, 12..14 small explosion frames, 15..17 claw/sting/bite creatures.
- **TR-n.EGA/.BAS** (&HBC6C): slot 0 typical (drawn as the XOR background pattern), 1 offensive, 2 inaccessible, 3 defensive terrain tiles.
- **DATA**: AttackVerb$ (line 241), TerrainName$ (297: index 1 Plains .. 13 Open Room), CmdName$ (6903), comms tables (7171/7172: CommMood! 5x3, CommRatio! 5x9, CommObjective! 5x4, read column-major as `(i, j)` -> `i + j*5`).

## Dead / unreferenced code

- 06F7-0715: credits DEF FN body with no caller.
- 0140-0167, 04F8-0650, 0716-0E33: only with `DebugLoad!` <> 0 (never set).
- 2983-299A ("Select Option"), 2F62-2FA5 (two LINE clears), 310A-3167 (item search), 3168-31A5 ("Can Not Carry Anymore Of That" / "Can Not Afford It"), 31AC-34B9 (member stat derivation), 352A-356F (typed yes/no), 89EA-8B79 (a beam variant with LINE (156,76)) : no label reaches them.
- A921-A92F: data tail.

## Unknowns / open questions

- No runtime call is unrendered.
- G!(6), G!(81), G!(109), G!(235), G!(285), G!(310..315), G!(330..339), G!(2236), G!(2237), G!(2240), G!(2263) are read or written only in the boarding epilogue / debug fill; their meanings belong to SPACE/SPBATTLE (the names `TowLinkCond!`, `KillPtr!`, `LastEnemyType!` are readings, M).
- `N_D2C4!` (added to the enemy hit chance) is never given a value; `N_D130!` is stored the constant 0 at 06480 and negated at 064CE: both are 0 at run time.
- Squad weapon record fields +8 and +10 (`WepReach!` = +10) are named by use only.
- The CGA portrait frame script reads `A_942E%` words 618.. of BIGSH-n.BAS; the data lane noted bytes after the picture in those files, this is their use.

SPBATTLE.header:
# SPBATTLE — BASIC-style pseudocode (lane mod-spbattle) — COMPLETE

Evidence: `decode/listings/SPBATTLE.lst` (regenerated after rt-naming), `decode/data/MODULE_CONSTANTS.md` (SPBATTLE.EXE section), `decode/data/tools/_SPBATTLE.json` (literal table, code end 0x7450), `decode/brun30/RT_LEDGER.md`, `decode/data/SPRITES.md` (SPBTSH.BAS, ENSHP-n.BAS, SPACESH.BAS inventories), `decode/data/DATA_FILES.md` (ENCLIST, ENCTABLE); read 2026-10-15. The codex draft `SPBATTLE.draft.md` was used only as a map of the string literals; every statement below is re-derived from the listing by `decode/pseudo/tools/qb2bas.py` run twice with `--names decode/pseudo/SPBATTLE_names.json --tempbase 6FAA` (the first pass writes `_spb_try.md.vars.json`). This file = `decode/pseudo/SPBATTLE_header.md` + the generated body. Screens and flows: `decode/pseudo/SPBATTLE_SCREENS.md`.

Translator note: the shared `qb2bas.py` initially crashed on `imul word ptr [bp - 0xc]` (SPBATTLE 0F2C); mod-inside committed the fix (c48ab36, `qb2bas done` in STATUS.md) and the body was regenerated with the shared translator; regenerated again after the PUT verb-map correction (541b493: 0 OR, 1 AND, 2 PRESET, 3 PSET, 4 XOR), which changed the verb word of every PUT (enemy/explosion/hit frames are OR, headers/player ship/saved areas PSET, the scan-map cell clear PRESET).

## Conventions

Same as `SPACE.bas.md`: labels = offsets, `SUB_XXXX` = near-call targets, `G!()` = the COMMON array at DS 0x1850 (fixed-index elements print as `G!(n)`, named COMMON scalars give their index in the Variables table), compiler temp slots T0..T24 at 0x6FAA + 8n (identified like SPACE's: the 268-byte gap 0x6F9E..0x70AA in the literal table, T0 = 0x6FAA used as the SHIP-n BLOAD offset at 0112 = `&H65FC`, T1 = 0x6FB2 as the ENSHP BLOAD offset at 0CAB = `&H6AA2`) are rendered as the expression they hold, FOR/NEXT reconstructed (the step, when not 1, is printed on the `NEXT x STEP s` line, never on the FOR line), bool idioms as relational values, `RETURN 'with FAC = ...` = value left in the accumulator.

DEF FN accessors inlined at every call site (bodies at the SUB_ addresses):

| FN | definition | body |
|---|---|---|
| `FNCrew(m, f)` | `INT(G!(m*100 + f + 1300) + .1)` crew-record field | SUB_0301 |
| `FNIdx(m, f)` | `INT(m*100 + f + 1300.5)` index of that field | SUB_0333 |
| `FNKey` | `INT(G!(78)*30000 + G!(79) + .5)` (no arguments) | 0352 (never called here) |
| `FNMod8(a)` | `a MOD 8` (heading wrap) | SUB_0CB1 |
| `FNDist(a, b)` | distance between ships a and b (5 = the player) | SUB_0CD1 |
| `FNAngle(a, b)` | bearing a -> b in degrees | SUB_0D2A |
| `FNInView(a)` | ship a inside the visual window | SUB_0DE2 |
| `FNNorm(a)` | angle to -180..180 | SUB_0E81 |
| `FNCanHit(a, b)` | gunner a (0..5 = member 3..8) can hit ship b: distance < 10, `ABS(ArcAngle!(a) - bearing + heading*45) < 60.5`, ship active, in view | SUB_0EAC |
| `FNSize(a)` | `EnTonnage!` (the same scalar for every enemy) or `BaseWt!` for the player (a = 5) | SUB_0FED |
| `FNScale(a)` | sprite scale factor by size | SUB_1033 |
| `FNShotX(a, b)` / `FNShotY(a, b)` | screen origin of weapon slot a of ship b | SUB_10B2 / SUB_1150 |

Per-enemy-ship state is a set of parallel arrays indexed 0..NumEnemy!-1 (`Hull!`, `EnArmor!`, `EnFuel!`, `EnX!`, `EnY!`, `EnHeading!`, `EnStatus!`, `CanMove!`, `CanTurn!`, `EnDefence!`, `Missiles!`) plus the 2-D `Shield!(facing, ship)` and the 6-slot `WeaponOK!`/`WeaponDmg!` (index `ship*6 + slot`; the translator's 2-D detection only recognises the `x + N*y` form, so these print with the explicit index). The player ship is index 5 in `FNDist`/`FNShotX` and sits at grid (`EnX!(5)`, `EnY!(5)`; the decode had rendered these direct operands as scalars `MyX!`/`MyY!` - sweep-folded); screen = grid*8 - (96,16) in the visual window, grid*5 + (-23, 24) on the scan map.

## Key map

| reader | keys | `Cmd!` |
|---|---|---|
| SUB_1C3B (movement phase) | extended keys -> scan code - 70 (2 Up, 5 Left, 7 Right, 10 Down); letters A..Z -> 12..37; cursor keys refused with "Pilot or ship not ready" (`Cmd! = 40`) unless member 1 is alive with field 17 > 0, `Fuel! > 0`, `G!(0) = G!(3) = 1` | dispatch 33A0: Up/Left/Right/Down move, A rotate CCW, B rotate CW, C enemy report, D visual, E skip, F switch, G time delay, H hyperspace |
| SUB_1857 (menus) | letters -> 1.. (A = 1), ENTER -51, SPACE -32, accepted within `CmdMin!..CmdMax!` | approaches 1..6, objectives 1..4, targeting 1..23 |
| SUB_1FD6 | Y/N | `YesNo!` |
| SUB_15A6 | ENTER 0, P 1, C 2, 1..6 -> 3..8 | `Member!` |

## G!() layout used by SPBATTLE (in addition to the SPACE table)

| indices | meaning | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | helm/engines flag, must be 1 to rotate | 4794 |
| 2 | life support ok (1) | 2C3A, 3024 |
| 4 | radio fitted | 2166 |
| 7..10 | shield fitted flags (facing 0..3) | 5E06, 1A37 |
| 11..16 | gun fitted flags (member m uses `G!(m+8)`) | 4A6E, 53E0 |
| 18 | missile killer active | 51C3 |
| 19 | hull state (2 = breached) | 6094, 136A |
| 60/61, 63/64 | missile killer / defence hardware fitted and % | 51C3, 51E8 |
| 67, 70, 73, 76 | shield strengths (`67 + 3f`) | 5E06, 136A, 7A5B in SPACE |
| 109 | special flag set when `EnBoardArg! = 23` | 73BD |
| 110..159 | mission flags (1 active -> 2 done by SUB_73A9) | 73C6 |
| 210..259 / 260..309, 310..315 | kill list and its pointers (`KillPtr!` ring of 50) | 2D80-2E53 |
| 340..369 | gun ammo stock | 548A-54F2 |
| 669 + 7m (m = 3..8) = 690 + 7(m-3) | gun record of member m: type, +1 damage, +2 ammo capacity, +4 accuracy, +5 loaded ammo, +6 shots per salvo | 53F7-5816 |
| crew fields | 1 initiative (fires when >= `TimeSlot!`), 10 hit bonus, 15 HP, 17 pilot skill (member 1), 18 gunnery, 23 comms (member 2), 26 repair, 31 status, 37 command (0 Wait .. 7 Rapid fire, 8 = fired), 38 target ship, 56 aim level | 5332-5455, 56FF, 4A6E-5145 |
| 2200.. | `Fuel!`, `ChainArg!` (= ENCLIST record on entry, = `EnBoardArg!` before PLBATTLE), `ShipHeading!`, `Terrain!`, `Surprise!`, mission codes, `Gravity10!`, `BoardCrew!` = boarded ship hull, `Breathable!`, `LastEnemyType!` last enemy type, `TributeCount!` tribute counter | Variables table |

## Manual corrections (translator limitations; the body text is as generated)

- 0741B `0 = Pad!` is a stray render of the padding bytes after the last `RETURN` at 7412 (the `' asm` lines up to 744E are data, not code).
- 13FF-1423 (`LOCATE 24,3: PRINT "Select Option"; GOSUB SUB_1857`) and 1F77-1FD5 (item search for `ItemType!`), 2042-2087 (three-letter yes/no) are unreferenced blocks (no `call`/`jmp` reaches them): compiled leftovers shared with SPACE.
- 0040-036E dead code: `DebugLoad!` (0x6F8E) is never assigned, so the standalone BLOADs, NAME/CHARNAME reads and the "Change things?" test-ship setup never run when CHAINed from SPACE.
- `AmmoCount!` (0x9EEE), `AllDead!` (0x9F4C), `ShieldNo!` (0x9F98), `EnemyLeft!` (0xA05E) are reused for a second purpose in the battle code; the Variables table names the primary use and lists the reuse.

## Unknowns

No runtime call is left unrendered. Open interpretation points (M in the Variables table): the meaning of ENCTABLE columns is derived only from how SPBATTLE consumes them (names `Tbl*`/`En*` are readings); `MoveDX!/MoveDY!` elements 1,3 / 0,2 are set at 0DC3-0DDC and the others are assumed 0 (never written); crew field 1 (initiative) and 56 (aim level) have no printed label.
